messages:
Sam (Marketing): We need a short execution sprint to get the webinar live next week. Topic idea: 'Production inference playbook: practical tradeoffs & demos'. Need speakers, run-of-show, lead-routing, and a rehearsal plan. Thoughts?
Priya (Events): I can run invites and rehearsal slots. Audience segmentation? Enterprise vs PLG? That affects CTA and routing.
Ethan (ML Eng): I'm good for the demo section. Prefer a 12-15m live demo + 3-4m prerecorded fallback. Will prepare a short script and test commands.
Lena (Product): Add two concrete customer scenarios (support bot + semantic search) and a one-slide TL;DR with recommended configs (latency target vs cost).
Alex (Infra): AV and infra notes:
- Reserve GPU instance for live demo
- Prewarm KV cache 10m before
- Record to S3 and enable captions
I'll post an AV runbook before tech check.
Maria (Sales): For lead routing include fields: company_size, timeline, use_case, interested_in_dedicated. Rules: enterprise -> AE, demo request -> SDR. I can own rule config and follow-up template.
Jenn (Content): I'll draft copy for the registration page and two short social posts (Twitter + LinkedIn). Include explicit consent for recording and follow-up.
Priya (Events): Calendar created: https://calendar.example.com/event/1807009999 (CalendarBot: event created). Rehearsal slots: Mon 10am PT (dry run), Wed 2pm PT (tech check). Please upload slides and demo script 24h before dry run.
Sam (Marketing): Run-of-show draft:
00:00-00:05 - Welcome & goals (Sam)
00:05-00:20 - Demo: low-latency path + fallback (Ethan)
00:20-00:30 - Use-cases & config TL;DR (Lena)
00:30-00:40 - Live Q&A (panel)
00:40-00:45 - CTA + lead capture (Sam)
00:45-01:00 - Optional 1:1s / deeper tech chat (Sales)

Ethan (ML Eng): Demo snippet I'll record for fallback:
```bash
# warm cache
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer -d '{"prompt":"warm"}'
```
Priya (Events): Action items: Sam confirm final speaker list by EOD, Maria draft routing & follow-up, Ethan upload prerecorded, Alex post AV runbook. React with :white_check_mark: when done.
Sam (Marketing): Confirming speakers now. I'll update the invite and ping when locked.
CalendarBot: Reminders set for dry run and tech check (auto-reminder sent).
